# Calendar-based reading statistics

This release adds date-aware reading statistics for devices with a real-time clock, with a compact implementation suitable for the X4 Pro.

## Added

- Reading time for today, the last 7 days, and the last 30 days.
- Current and longest reading streaks, tracked globally and per book.
- Per-book start and completion dates in the statistics data model.
- Reading-time distribution by time of day and day of week for future statistics views.
- Calendar arithmetic tests covering leap years, date boundaries, and weekdays.

## Improved

- Reading time now follows the period while book text is visible and pauses while another screen is open.
- Existing version 1 and version 2 statistics files are migrated automatically when they are next saved.
- Statistics storage refuses to overwrite files created by an unknown newer format.

## Notes

- New dated history starts accumulating after installing this release; existing all-time totals are preserved.
- Recent daily totals have five-second precision, while reading-day history retains 366 days for streak calculations.
